verdict.rationale: Brex documents coding spend at the point of purchase. AI agents categorize spend instantly against policy (brex-docs-41, brex-docs-8), and AI assistants write memos and fetch receipts (brex-docs-23). Receipts are uploaded and auto-matched to existing expenses (brex-docs-7, brex-docs-54). Coded data syncs to accounting through an Accounting API and one-click accounting, with 'close the books in real time' positioning (brex-docs-59, brex-docs-17, brex-docs-37). A community commenter corroborates auto-generated receipts and data enrichment (brex-comm-4). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of merchant-data enrichment and GL/category mapping depth (the Fields API supports only single-select dropdowns), and hands-on evidence of close-time accuracy beyond marketing claims.
